color.note: Dark-only. Each theme is a color scheme the user picks in Settings: the accent changes and the neutrals take a faint tint of it. Never offer a light mode.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything. The full-page menu also sits on it.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Cards, dashboard widgets, module tiles at rest.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of surface-1, inputs, nested rows inside a card.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Popovers, dropdowns, toasts: anything floating above cards.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline around cards and between list rows. Decorative only; never the sole marker of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button outlines. Holds 3:1 on bg, surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on bg, surface-1, surface-2 and surface-3.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, metadata, timestamps on bg, surface-1, surface-2 and surface-3.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, captions and uppercase labels on bg, surface-1 and surface-2 (4.5:1 or better). Not for anything the user must read to act.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The scheme color: primary buttons, active menu item, focus ring, progress fills, key numbers. One accent element per view region.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Hover state of accent fills; accent text on accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds: selected rows, chips, the icon well of a module tile.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. Never use white on accent.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done, paid, in stock. Always paired with a check icon or the word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Due soon, low budget. Always paired with an icon or the word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Overdue, over budget, destructive actions. Always paired with an icon or the word.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind dialogs and sheets.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Dashboard greeting only. One per screen.

styles.name: menu-item
styles.usage: Module names in the full-page menu.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pick up the cake on the way home.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body copy, button labels.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata and helper text, in text-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows above cards and sections, in text-subtle.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The headline figure of a stat card.

styles.name: num
styles.usage: Times, counts and amounts inside lists. Tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related elements inside a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List row vertical padding, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter, gap between dashboard cards on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between dashboard cards on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter, space between page sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between header and first section; menu item rhythm on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top and bottom padding of the full-page menu.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, checkboxes, small icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list rows with a fill.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, module tiles, sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, pills, the scheme picker swatches.

shadow.note: Dark UI: depth comes from lighter surfaces, not shadows. Only floating layers get one.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Popovers, dropdowns, toasts on surface-3.
